blocks.text: A new location, a larger customer base, or an additional supplier can mark an important step forward for a company. Each also adds to the financial activity that keeps the business moving. There are more obligations to schedule, more collections to monitor, and more information to bring together for decisions. For business owners and finance leaders, keeping a clear view of these activities becomes increasingly valuable. Metrobank Business Online Solutions (MBOS), a corporate cash management platform helps companies manage payments and collections through digital services that support scheduling, transaction tracking and approval controls.
